fee_notes: Royalty 8% of Gross Revenues, payable monthly by 10th. National Marketing Fund: greater of $2,000/year or up to 3% (currently 2%) of Gross Revenues, paid monthly. Marketing Access Fee: $100/month. Technology Access Fee: $227-$500/month (midpoint ~$363). Local advertising: $3,000/year minimum first 2 years, then greater of $3,000 or 3% of prior year GR.
